title: Products: rings into things people want
summary: Wearables, symbols, everyday items, patches, custom logos, wall art, DIY kits, pattern files, and gift lines — one medium, many SKUs.

blocks.title: What the rings become
blocks.body: Every line below is the same craft under a different label. Start narrow (a few hearts and letters), then add lines only when content and orders ask for them.

blocks.heading: Product families
blocks.caption: Illustrative catalog — not a finished SKU list.

blocks.heading: Ship a thin first shelf
blocks.body: Founders do not need nine families on day one. Five to ten designs that photograph cleanly beat a bloated catalog. Add a family when you can show a clip, a listing, and a path to fulfill the order.

blocks.title: Kits and patterns are products too
blocks.body: Finished pieces sell the dream. Kits and pattern files sell the craft. Both feed the same content loop and the same community gallery.

blocks.heading: After you pick a shelf
items: Pick three shapes that read in a three-second clip.
Decide which are finished goods vs kit vs pattern-only.
